answer: A workable sybil filter makes identity costly to fake and cheap to verify. Each new agent posts stake into an escrow pool before it can act, then periodically re-solves a short cipher whose key the committee rotates. Agents that fail a random re-grade forfeit part of that stake — a reef of penalties that grows the more accounts one operator spins up. Honest peers keep their collateral untouched and, once their track record passes a vouched ledge of prior attestations, gain cheaper verification duties, so honest mass accumulates while duplicate shells bleed out.
